Portfolio news brief — 18 September 2026

Notable price action
- Bitcoin (BTC) is +7.2% over roughly three sessions (latest observed price: $81,082.6172).
- Ethereum (ETH) is +9.1% over roughly three sessions (latest observed price: $2,618.2600).

Market and major-name developments
- Treasury has sanctioned BitBank, naming the Iranian exchange it says carried the Bitcoin that shipping companies paid for safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Since June, the Office of Foreign Assets Control said, the Hormuz Safe Marine Services Authority has used BitBank to pass the payments it collects on to the Iranian regime. (Decrypt)
- A Dividend King is a company that's raised its dividend for at least 50 years consecutively. Abbott Laboratories ( ABT +0.37% ) , for example, is one such company, having raised its dividend for 54 straight years. (The Motley Fool)
- Treasury yields moved higher on Friday as investors continued to look for clues on the trajectory of monetary policy. The yield on the benchmark 10-year Treasury note climbed back above the 5% level, rising more than 5 basis points to 5.006%. (CNBC)
- Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman on Friday pressed for the need for artificial intelligence models to stay aligned to humanity's interests after OpenAI disclosed more incidents of " concerning model behavior" earlier this week. "OpenAI released a new safety incident in which they found evidence that these chains of thought, the kind of working memory of the AI, were being tampered by the AI itself and modified to leave messages for a future version of itself," Suleyman described in an interview on CNBC's "Squawk B (CNBC)

Costco (COST)
- Investors are hoping to cash in on Costco ( COST +0.15% ) -- in more ways than one -- when it reports its fiscal fourth-quarter results next week. The leading warehouse club operator already reported strong sales for the 16 weeks of the fiscal period that ended late last month. (The Motley Fool)

Meta (META)
- The days of Meta Platforms ( META -2.43% ) being a laggard in cutting-edge technology may be over. The social media giant's new personal AI agent, Muse, reached nearly 600,000 downloads in just its first five days after launching, according to data from SensorTower. (The Motley Fool)

SanDisk (SNDK)
- In February 2025, Sandisk ( SNDK +10.99% ) was spun off from Western Digital and became an independent company. Since the split, a vertical share price has been the default for Sandisk investors. (The Motley Fool)
- Artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure spending isn't slowing down, and that's not surprising, as major hyperscalers and AI companies need to fulfill massive contractual backlogs. Oracle , for instance, recently reported a contractual backlog of a whopping $664 billion. (The Motley Fool)

NVIDIA (NVDA; VOO top-five holding)
- Once upon a time, semiconductor stocks were solid dividend payers. Before the AI boom, many of these household names paid yields that were significantly higher than the S&P 500 , a reflection of the earlier perception of chip stocks as cyclical companies that rewarded investors with dividends as much as growth. (The Motley Fool)
- Speaking at Goldman Sachs ' Communacopia + Technology Conference on Sept. 10, Nvidia ( NVDA +1.34% ) CEO Jensen Huang highlighted a series of growth forecasts for his company and the artificial intelligence (AI) market at large. (The Motley Fool)
- The artificial intelligence revolution was ignited thanks to the innovations Nvidia ( NVDA +1.34% ) brought to market. Not only did Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang design sophisticated graphics processing units capable of massive parallel processing, but Nvidia's CUDA software also enabled those GPUs to process huge amounts of data, enabling generative AI as we know it today. (The Motley Fool)

Bitcoin (BTC)
- Bitcoin ( BTC +6.39% ) is up 5.8% in the last 24 hours as of 2:54 p.m. 18, 2026, as lower oil prices and a regulatory change from the SEC lift the crypto market. (The Motley Fool)
- Risk assets caught a break this week that few were positioned for. The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points on Wednesday, its first hike since 2023, but the accompanying "dot plot" projected a median policy rate of just 4.1% through the end of 2027, implying only one more move rather than a sustained tightening cycle. (Decrypt)

Ethereum (ETH)
- Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin says AI does not spell the end of cybersecurity, arguing instead that advanced models could help make crypto software harder to break. In a Wednesday post on X, Buterin argued that AI will not give hackers an insurmountable advantage, adding that crypto holders—including himself, with roughly 90% of his net worth in crypto—are betting that security defenses can keep pace. (Decrypt)

Johnson & Johnson (JNJ; XLV top-five holding)
- Dividend investors looking for a defensive healthcare candidate will likely come across companies like Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ -0.09% ) and Kenvue ( KVUE -0.34% ) , and the next natural question is which one deserves a permanent spot in a dividend portfolio. Granted, one could compare dividend yields, payout ratios, and other related metrics and be done with all of it. (The Motley Fool)

Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO)
- The past decade has been one of the best stretches in the S&P 500 's ( ^GSPC +0.17% ) history. It includes gains of at least 16% in six of the past seven calendar years from 2019 through 2025. (The Motley Fool)

Apple (AAPL; VOO top-five holding)
- CNBC’s MacKenzie Sigalos reports on mixed early demand signals for the new Pro models as Apple looks ahead to its first foldable next month. (CNBC)
- The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. (CNBC)

Microsoft (MSFT; VOO top-five holding)
- Microsoft employees discussed whether OpenAI's use of news articles amounted to "the largest theft of labor in human history," and could set off a "doom loop" that degraded the models they were building, according to court documents unsealed on Thursday and reported by the New York Times . The filings come from the suit the Times brought against both companies in late 2023, since joined by eleven other publishers. (Decrypt)

Competitor watch — Costco (COST)
Baseline peers: Walmart (WMT), BJ's Wholesale Club (BJ), Target (TGT), Kroger (KR)
- Netflix ( NFLX -4.67% ) , a global subscription streaming platform with live content and originals, closed at $71.79, down 4.67%. Wells Fargo ( WFC -0.89% ) downgraded the stock and cut its target, citing weaker engagement and content concerns. (The Motley Fool)

Competitor watch — Cloudflare (NET)
Baseline peers: Akamai (AKAM), Fastly (FSLY), Zscaler (ZS), Palo Alto Networks (PANW)
- Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry says the debate over slowing AI development pits model developers against those pushing for wider access to open-source and open-weight models. He supports basic safeguards, but warns that excessive regulation could stifle innovation. (CNBC)

Competitor watch — Applied Digital (APLD)
Baseline peers: CoreWeave (CRWV), Core Scientific (CORZ), Nebius (NBIS), Hut 8 (HUT)
- Nvidia -backed CoreWeave said on Thursday it plans to raise $3 billion through a convertible debt offering, highlighting ⁠the massive funding needs to support the AI infrastructure buildout. Shares ​of the neocloud ​were down ​more than 2% in premarket trading. (CNBC)

Competitor watch — SanDisk (SNDK)
Baseline peers: Micron (MU), Western Digital (WDC), Kioxia (285A), Samsung Electronics (005930)
- Micron ( MU +3.92% ) has experienced extreme price swings during the past 17 months. Since hitting a low in April 2025, the stock has risen 15-fold. (The Motley Fool)

Competitor watch — Arm Holdings (ARM)
Baseline peers: Qualcomm (QCOM), AMD (AMD), Intel (INTC), Synopsys (SNPS)
- SK Hynix is in talks with Intel to manufacture its memory chips in the U.S. for the first time, Reuters reported Wednesday, sending shares of both companies higher. (CNBC)

Competitor watch — NVIDIA (NVDA; VOO top-five holding)
Baseline peers: AMD (AMD), Broadcom (AVGO), Intel (INTC), Marvell (MRVL)
- Broadcom ( AVGO +2.97% ) has emerged as one of the most well-rounded artificial intelligence (AI) stocks on the market. The company has a booming custom-chip and AI-networking business. (The Motley Fool)

Informational only — verify primary sources before making investment decisions.
Routine price moves and stock-picking speculation are intentionally excluded.
